name: FilterBar
description: List-page filter strip: search field, filter controls, reset affordance and trailing actions.
designIntent: Filter rows drift: some pages wrap, some scroll, resets appear inconsistently. FilterBar fixes the order (search → filters → reset → trailing) and keeps the strip compact on narrow screens.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Fires on each keystroke; hides the search box when omitted.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Search input placeholder (also its accessible name).

props.name: onReset
props.description: Shows a reset button when provided.

props.name: activeCount
props.description: Active filter count appended to the reset and filter labels.

props.name: onOpenFilters
props.description: Shows a Filters button and opens a filter panel or mobile drawer.

props.name: resultsCount
props.description: Result count shown before the trailing slot.

examples.title: List filters
examples.code:
<FilterBar
  searchValue={query}
  onSearchChange={setQuery}
  searchPlaceholder="Search students"
  onReset={resetFilters}
  activeCount={activeFilters}
  onOpenFilters={() => setPanelOpen(true)}
  resultsCount={312}
>
  <Select label="Status" options={statusOptions} />
</FilterBar>
examples.description: Search, filters, reset and count in one strip.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put the primary action in the bar
antiPatterns.explanation: FilterBar is for narrowing; creation actions belong in PageHeader actions.

accessibility.implementation: Wraps controls in role=search; the search input is labelled by its placeholder
